summary: Iteration 25 - System Administration (sysadmin role) feature verified end-to-end. Backend pytest test_sysadmin.py: 18/18 PASS covering (a) sysadmin login returns role=sysadmin; (b) GET /api/system/db-stats returns counts for all 9+2 collections as sysadmin (200) and 403 for admin & trader; (c) GET /api/system/export/{entity} works for deals (CSV+JSON), banks (JSON), bank_accounts (CSV), users (CSV header excludes password_hash); invalid entity returns 400; admin gets 403; (d) POST /api/system/db-reset returns 400 on wrong confirm, 403 for admin/trader, and on confirm='RESET DATABASE' wipes deals+audit_logs+counters while retaining users/companies/currencies counts (verified via pre/post db-stats); (e) sysadmin inherits admin perms - can list /api/users, /api/audit-logs, /api/reports/deal-blotter (all 200). Frontend Playwright on https://fx-deal-queue.preview.emergentagent.com: (1) sysadmin login succeeds, sidebar nav shows: Dashboard, Reference Data, Users, Transactions, Audit Trail, Reports, System (System present). (2) /system route renders system-page with Database Overview, Export Data, Danger Zone cards. (3) All 9 entities (deals, audit_logs, users, companies, banks, bank_accounts, currencies, transaction_types, transfer_types) have export-{entity}-csv and export-{entity}-json buttons. (4) Reset Database dialog: reset-confirm-btn disabled when empty, disabled with 'wrong text', enabled only when exactly 'RESET DATABASE' typed. (5) Admin sidebar nav does NOT include System (gated via roleConfig). Note: admin can still navigate to /system via direct URL - page renders shell but db-stats API returns 403 producing 'Failed to load database stats' toast (backend correctly enforces, but no client-side route guard).

issues: Admin can navigate directly to /system via URL. Page UI renders (Export/Reset buttons visible) but every API call 403s and shows error toast. Recommend a client-side route guard (PrivateRoute checking role==='sysadmin') that redirects admin/trader to /dashboard. Backend security is correctly enforced (403); this is UX-only.
React console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' - add a DialogDescription or aria-describedby for accessibility compliance.

action_items: [Low/UX] Add client-side route guard on /system that redirects non-sysadmin users (admin/trader) to /dashboard - currently page renders shell + API 403 toast.
[Low/a11y] Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to reset-confirm-dialog to silence Radix accessibility warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1471-1515 - /api/system/export/{entity} loads up to 200,000 docs into memory then builds CSV in StringIO. For deals collection with audit data this can OOM under load. Consider streaming response (StreamingResponse) with a generator yielding rows, especially for audit_logs which can grow unbounded.

server.py L1499 skip_keys hardcoded to {settlement_proofs, history, password_hash}. Good for users/deals but if future entities add sensitive fields (e.g. api_keys, tokens) they will be exported. Consider declarative per-entity column allowlist instead of denylist.
server.py L1517-1526 db-stats does count_documents on 11 collections sequentially - on a large DB this is slow. Use asyncio.gather() to parallelize counts.

server.py L1448-1469 db-reset is irreversible and has no soft-delete/backup step. Recommend an automatic export of deals+audit_logs to /tmp or S3 before wipe so a sysadmin mistake is recoverable. At minimum, log the wiped counts to a persistent audit_logs entry BEFORE deleting audit_logs (currently audit is wiped without a final record).

SystemPage.jsx L60 uses responseType:'blob' for JSON exports too. The blob download works but the server returns proper Content-Disposition - consider opening JSON in a new tab for inspection rather than forcing download. Minor UX preference.

Layout.jsx L47-55 sysadmin nav duplicates admin nav + System. Refactor to spread admin items: sysadmin: [...roleConfig.admin, {to:'/system', icon:Settings, label:'System'}] to avoid drift when admin nav changes.
App.js L102 - /system route is not wrapped in a role-protecting component; rely solely on backend 403. Add <PrivateRoute requireRole='sysadmin'> wrapper.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 flows - sysadmin login, sidebar, /system render, 9 entity buttons, reset dialog gating, admin sidebar exclusion)

This wiped all deals, audit_logs, counters, report_permissions from the DB. Users and reference data (companies/banks/bank_accounts/currencies/transaction_types/transfer_types) are intact. Any TEST_ deals from iteration 24 are gone. Next testing agent should re-create deals via API if needed for deal/treasury flow regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sysadmin endpoints: POST /api/system/db-reset (body: {confirm:'RESET DATABASE'}), GET /api/system/export/{entity}?format=csv|json (entities: deals, audit_logs, users, companies, banks, bank_accounts, currencies, transaction_types, transfer_types), GET /api/system/db-stats. require_role() now grants sysadmin access whenever 'admin' is in allowed roles (server.py L193-200). Frontend selectors: system-page, refresh-stats-btn, export-{entity}-csv, export-{entity}-json, reset-db-btn, reset-confirm-dialog, reset-confirm-input, reset-confirm-btn. DB was reset during this test run so deals/audit collections start empty. Sysadmin sidebar includes System; admin sidebar does NOT.
rca of the issue: No bugs blocking the feature. Two minor UX notes: (1) /system route lacks client-side role guard - admin can land on the page but backend returns 403 so data is never leaked; (2) Radix Dialog missing aria description for a11y.
